description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of data across six distinct categories, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and its proportion of the total. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each category to its color and exact count: 'chat' (546,526), 'math' (290,496), 'tooluse' (154,358), 'multi turn chat' (123,615), 'code' (119,563), and 'instruction follow' (91,460). The largest segment, colored pink, represents 'chat' at 41.2%. The second largest, colored blue, is 'math' at 21.9%. The remaining four segments are smaller: 'tooluse' (green, 11.6%), 'multi turn chat' (orange, 9.3%), 'code' (purple, 9.0%), and 'instruction follow' (pink, approximately 7.0%, though not explicitly labeled with a percentage in the chart). Each category is also labeled with its percentage directly on the chart, positioned adjacent to its corresponding slice. The chart does not show any exploded or emphasized slices, nor does it appear to have any specific ordering beyond the visual size of the segments.
